description: University of Auckland Reinforced Concrete Prism Tests is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Rick Henry, University of Auckland (aucklanduni.ac.nz). A series of tests of reinforced concrete (RC) prisms representing the end regions of RC walls were conducted at the University of Auckland to investigate the performance of lightly reinforced concrete walls subjected to dynamic loading rates expected during earthquakes. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Reinforced Concrete, Walls, Prisms, Seismic Performance, Loading Rate. Published 2023-08-11. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
